sourceInputs.userInstruction: Seed the Testhaus Leo source folder as target-house-2 via the sketch-to-BIM methodology.

visualRead.primaryView: 1956 double-house drawings with floor plans, elevations, section, and current expose
visualRead.style: traditional two-storey German semi-detached residential building with basement, pitched roof, dormers, and paired mirrored halves

dominantVolumes.description: Full paired 19.80 m by 8.75 m building footprint, mirrored along the central party-wall/stair zone.
Continuous pitched tiled roof with two primary dormer zones on each long roof face and gable elevations at both ends.
Two mirrored residential halves; Weidenstrasse 6 is the current sales/object evidence context.

nonNegotiables: building must be centered on terrain/toposolid
doors and windows must be hosted on walls
furniture markers must remain inside their rooms and never on stairs
basement, ground floor, dachgeschoss, and roof datum must be explicit
DIN 283 room areas from the source must be preserved as target area metadata
forbiddenOutcomes: single generic box without room/level semantics
visual-only shell without BIM room, type, and evidence metadata

sourceNotes: Umbauter Raum.pdf lists built area per half as 19.80/2 * 8.75 = 86.625 m2.
Wohnflaechenberechnung.pdf lists one half as EG 61.61 m2, DG 54.42 m2, total 116.03 m2.
